text: Resonator adalah individu di Solaris-3 yang bisa beresonansi dengan objek atau elemen tertentu dan memanipulasi frekuensinya. Aku dan kamu termasuk di dalamnya, Rover!
text_en: Resonators are individuals on Solaris-3 who can resonate with specific elements and alter frequencies. That includes both you and me, Rover!

text: Pengalaman masa lalu dan alam bawah sadar diyakini membentuk Forte seorang Resonator. Saat terbangun, gen mereka berevolusi dan meninggalkan Resonance Spectrum Pattern unik.
text_en: Past memories and the subconscious shape a Resonator's Forte. Upon Awakening, their genetic spectrum forms a unique Resonance Pattern.

text: Saat Awakening, fisik dan mental Resonator meningkat drastis: kekuatan, kelincahan, refleks, dan daya tahan, bahkan beberapa mengalami mutasi fisik unik di tubuhnya, Rover.
text_en: Upon Awakening, Resonators gain enhanced strength, agility, and reflexes, with some developing distinctive physical mutations, Rover.

text: Resonator peka membaca informasi dan emosi yang tertinggal pada benda atau lokasi lewat frekuensi. Roccia misalnya, ahli membedakan frekuensi yang bercampur!
text_en: Resonators can read lingering emotions and data in objects through frequencies. Roccia, for instance, excels at sorting blended frequencies!

text: Tiap Resonator punya trik unik, Rover: Camellya, Phrolova, dan Phoebe bisa terbang sendiri, sedangkan Ciaccona dan Cristoforo punya akses ke Sonoro Sphere!
text_en: Every Resonator has unique quirks: Camellya, Phrolova, and Phoebe can fly, while Ciaccona and Cristoforo hold access to Sonoro Spheres!

text: Fakta seru: Resonator bisa mengubah kelebihan kalori menjadi energi lain agar berat badannya tidak naik, seperti yang dilakukan Zani. Enak buat yang suka jajan, haha!
text_en: Fun fact: Resonators can burn excess calories into pure energy to avoid weight gain, just like Zani does! Perfect for foodies, haha!

text: Catatan masa kecil Luuk Herssen menyebut Resonator hidup jauh lebih lama dan menua lebih lambat dari manusia biasa. Mornye bahkan tidak berubah setelah 20 tahun!
text_en: Luuk Herssen's notes state Resonators age much slower and live longer than ordinary humans. Mornye hasn't aged a bit even after 20 years!

text: Kata Suisui, usia Resonator tetap berbatas walau Muyu hidup lebih dari dua abad. Ada juga yang menahan penuaan lewat eksperimen Fractsidus seperti Camellya atau obsesi seperti Suoming.
text_en: Suisui says Resonator lifespans still have limits though Muyu lived over two centuries. Others stall aging via Fractsidus experiments or obsession.

text: Di Huanglong, praktisi seperti Qingxiao melatih tubuh dan pikiran lewat kultivasi untuk menahan penuaan dan mencapai Mindscape Sonoro Sphere, sementara Buling memakai jimat.
text_en: In Huanglong, masters like Qingxiao cultivate mind and body to slow aging and access Mindscape Sonoro Spheres, while Buling relies on talismans.

text: Saat mental dan emosi Resonator terkuras, mereka bisa mengalami Overclocking: lepas kendali atas Forte hingga membahayakan diri dan sekitar. Jangan terlalu lelah ya, Rover!
text_en: When a Resonator's mind is depleted, they may suffer Overclocking—losing control of their Forte and endangering all around. Don't overwork, Rover!

text: Setiap Resonator memiliki Forte Examination Report resmi yang mencatat status kekuatan, kurva Rabelle, dan risiko Overclocking. Punyaku dulu tercatat di arsip akademi!
text_en: Every Resonator has an official Forte Examination Report documenting powers, Rabelle curve, and Overclocking risk. Mine is filed in the academy!

text: Dalam permainan, Resonator direkrut lewat Convene memakai Radiant atau Lustrous Tide dari event, eksplorasi, Pioneer Podcast, atau ditukar dengan 160 Astrite dan Coral.
text_en: In-game, Resonators are recruited through Convene using Radiant or Lustrous Tides from events, quests, Pioneer Podcast, or traded for Astrite and Coral.

text: Resonator asal Huanglong sangat banyak, Rover! Termasuk Jianxin, Jiyan, Lingyang, Yinlin, Jinhsi, Changli, Zhezhi, Xiangli Yao, Qiuyuan, Suisui, Qingxiao, Jingran, Hsin, dan Suoming.
text_en: Huanglong has so many Resonators, Rover! Including Jianxin, Jiyan, Lingyang, Yinlin, Jinhsi, Changli, Zhezhi, Xiangli Yao, Qiuyuan, and more.

text: Selain itu, deretan Resonator Huanglong lainnya ada Yangyang (termasuk wujud Xuanling), Baizhi, Chixia, Danjin, Sanhua, Taoqi, Yuanwu, Youhu, Lumi, serta Buling!
text_en: Other prominent Huanglong Resonators include Yangyang, Baizhi, Chixia, Danjin, Sanhua, Taoqi, Yuanwu, Youhu, Lumi, and Buling!

text: Dari wilayah New Federation, ada Calcharo, Encore, Verina, Lynae, Mornye, Luuk Herssen, Lucilla, Aalto, dan Mortefi. Banyak wajah yang sudah kamu kenal baik, kan Rover?
text_en: From the New Federation, we have Calcharo, Encore, Verina, Lynae, Mornye, Luuk Herssen, Lucilla, Aalto, and Mortefi. Quite a few familiar faces, right?

text: Resonator dari Rinascita meliputi Carlotta, Roccia, Phoebe, Brant, Cantarella, Zani, Ciaccona, Cartethyia, Lupa, Augusta, Iuno, dan Galbrena!
text_en: Rinascita Resonators feature Carlotta, Roccia, Phoebe, Brant, Cantarella, Zani, Ciaccona, Cartethyia, Lupa, Augusta, Iuno, and Galbrena!

text: Dari kampung halamanku Lahai-Roi tercatat aku (Aemeath) dan Sigrika! Sedangkan dari Ashinohara ada Chisa dan Hiyuki, ditambah kolaborasi Lucy dan Rebecca.
text_en: From my hometown Lahai-Roi there is me (Aemeath) and Sigrika! Ashinohara features Chisa and Hiyuki, plus the crossovers Lucy and Rebecca.

text: Untuk Resonator lintas wilayah atau kelompok khusus, wiki mencatat dirimu (Rover), Shorekeeper dari Black Shores, Camellya, Phrolova, serta Denia.
text_en: For cross-regional and faction Resonators, the wiki records yourself (Rover), Shorekeeper of Black Shores, Camellya, Phrolova, and Denia.
